summary: Verified server-side prerender (/api/prerender) + client-side SEO meta after full SEO/prerender overhaul. Existing pytest suite (test_prerender.py 11, test_dedupe_twins.py 4) all pass; wrote test_prerender_extended.py (10 new tests) covering the review request gaps and everything passes. Frontend Playwright checks on the deployed preview confirm client-side meta, filter noindex, junk-make 404 (no silent redirect), and language switching.
